data.one_liner: Customizable Flutter dropdown button with advanced styling and multi-select support
data.what_it_does: Provides a DropdownButton2 widget that extends Flutter’s core dropdown with features like custom positioning, scrollable menus, multi-select, searchable lists, and form integration via DropdownButtonFormField2.
use_when: Need a dropdown with custom styling or positioning
Want to integrate a dropdown into a Form with validation
avoid_when: Working on a very small project where the default DropdownButton suffices
Need a dropdown that supports complex animations beyond what this package offers
strengths: Rich set of customization options (offset, max height, scrollbar, custom button)
Supports multi-select and searchable dropdowns out of the box
weaknesses: No support for async data loading or network integration
Requires manual handling of ValueListenable for state management
No built‑in theming beyond basic styles
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, and use the widget directly
data.minimal_example:
```dart
DropdownButton2<String>(
  items: ['One', 'Two', 'Three'].map((e) => DropdownMenuItem(value: e, child: Text(e))).toList(),
  valueListenable: ValueNotifier<String?>('One'),
  onChanged: (v) => print(v),
)
```
